definitions.explanation: explaining or justifying one's actions, often to avoid blame or criticism

examples.japanese: {弁解|べんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{余地|よち}→余地：07612_yochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no room for excuses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弁解|べんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧とした。
examples.english: He tried to make an excuse for being late.

examples.japanese: {弁解|べんかい}がましいこと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}いたくない→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to make excuse-like statements.

examples.japanese: ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧{弁解|べんかい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{通|とお}用⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a situation where no excuse would work.

notes:
{弁解|べんかい} refers to explaining or justifying one's actions, typically when facing criticism or blame. It often carries a slightly negative nuance of making excuses.

WRITING:
- {弁|べん} (speak, explain, argue)
- {解|かい} (solve, explain, untie)

USAGE:
- {弁解|べんかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make an excuse, to justify - suru verb)
- {弁解|べんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{余地|よち}→余地：07612_yochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (no room for excuses)
- {弁解|べんかい}がましい (excuse-like, seeming to make excuses)
- Can be neutral (explanation) or negative (excuse-making)
- Often implies the speaker is at fault
- More formal than ⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧ (excuse - colloquial)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {弁解|べんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試|こころ}みる→試みる：01943_kokoromiru⟧ (to attempt an excuse)
- {弁解|べんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終始|しゅうし}→終始：15291_shuushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to end up just making excuses)
- ⟦{苦|くる}しい→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧{弁解|べんかい} (a weak/painful excuse)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{弁明|べんめい}→弁明：08007_benmei⟧ - more formal defense/vindication
- ⟦{釈明|しゃくめい}→釈明：07640_shakumei⟧ - more formal explanation/clarification
- ⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧ - casual excuse

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{弁明|べんめい}→弁明：08007_benmei⟧ (vindication, explanation)
- ⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧ (excuse)
- ⟦{釈明|しゃくめい}→釈明：07640_shakumei⟧ (explanation, clarification)
- {正当化|せいとうか} (justification)
